subject: Archaeology
title: The Epic of Gilgamesh
description: One-minute skill: The Epic of Gilgamesh.

hook.text: The oldest known story is about a king who fights monsters, loses his best friend, and searches for immortality.

buildup.text: Gilgamesh was king of Uruk. He and his wild friend Enkidu fought the demon Humbaba and killed the Bull of Heaven.

discovery.text: When Enkidu died, Gilgamesh searched for immortality. He found a plant that restored youth — then a snake stole it.

twist.text: The story includes a great flood nearly identical to Noah's. A man builds a boat, loads animals, and sends out a dove.

climax.text: George Smith translated the flood tablet in 1872 at the British Museum and was so excited he began undressing in public.

punchline.text: The oldest story ever written is about grief, friendship, and accepting death.

quiz.question: What shocking parallel does the Epic of Gilgamesh contain?
options: A creation story nearly identical to Genesis chapter one
A great flood story nearly identical to Noah's Ark — with a boat and animals
A Tower of Babel story explaining why languages differ
